chunks: And from his words (peace be upon him) regarding what he returned to the Muslims from the land grants of 'Uthman.

key_terms.عُثْمَانَ: Uthman ibn Affan, the third Rashidun Caliph
key_terms.قَطَائِعِ: Land grants or estates given by the ruler to individuals or tribes

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about returning Uthman's land grants to the Muslims?
ai.summary: Imam Ali’s (AS) decision to redistribute the land grants (qata'i) of Uthman reflects the Shia scholarly view that these were personal stipends rather than permanent endowments, thereby restoring public wealth to the treasury. This administrative correction underscores the principle of equitable resource distribution and serves as a foundational precedent for fiscal justice in early Islamic governance.
